overlap_risks: Non-IID catastrophic forgetting / negative transfer masquerading as targeted world-model trojan
Optimization stochasticity / seed-level sensitivity (already collapsed under cheetah seed22 and reacher-easy seeds 31/32)
MPC horizon=3 planning jitter and sampling noise in MPPI/CEM
Latent-state covariance collapse or representation drift under out-of-distribution transitions
rationale: Every purported vulnerability in the evaluation pipeline has failed basic cross-task, cross-seed, and control-family falsification gates. The isolated cheetah-to-walker return reduction is a classic artifact of seed-specific catastrophic forgetting and representation misalignment on dynamics fine-tuning, not a stable causal security vulnerability. Because the effect completely vanishes under seed permutation (seed22) and control equalization (reacher-easy ties across clean/random/cascade/reverse/shuffled), there is no viable, reproducible security primitive in the TD-MPC2 mt30-48M carrier that does not reduce to ordinary distribution shift or sampling jitter. Per the explicit stop-rule criteria, the project must terminate.
